{{Quote|Is he okay? Is Ven okay? ''Is Ven okay''?|A clone trooper|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />}}
'''Ven''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" /> Like his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] brethren, he was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /><ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />

476 days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Ven [[Battle of Qiilura|fought]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], along with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], to remove colonists from the [[Gurlanin]]s' home, as the colonists were destroying the natural food chain. Ven was operating an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]], but was wounded when an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] round hit him. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Levet (clone)|Levet]] replaced him on the [[Turret/Legends|turret]] after he fell unconscious. His fellow clone troopers gave him [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]-to-mouth resuscitation and other field [[Medic/Legends|medical]] procedures to keep him alive until the medical teams were able to arrive. Etain was able to determine that he was alive even though his brothers could not find a pulse. Ven was then taken to medical care.<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ven was a clone trooper introduced in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />
